question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the released `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or should this issue and the open closing PR be closed as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can verify both sides of the split, but choosing whether a shipped helper remains a supported surface is a maintainer product-boundary decision.

options.title: Retire the helper surface
options.body: Close the open closing PR and this issue together after documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

options.title: Support the shipped helper
options.body: Refresh or backport the parser repair, keep original invalid-token diagnostics, and run the focused skill-creator script tests before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Retire the helper surface
recommendation.body: Close the open closing PR and this issue together after documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill surface traces to steipete, making this the clearest available owner for the support-boundary choice.
